title: A coin for the road
creator: your-handle
description: A quest with a find step: the journal shows the clue, never a count. Use find when the thing comes only from digging, or from one plant that opens at certain hours.

quest.summary: Pell wants an old coin for luck. Something about the gate rubble.

steps.clue: Old pottery lies under the gate stones. The coin is in the same rubble, Pell says, if the mist left it there.
